authority.note: The sealed hallway architecture gives Earth the elevated climb above the performers and the overlook signature move; the Phase 0 canon row gives the verb COMPARE, the barrier ELEVATION and the payoff of three unison figures aligned. The 2026-09-08 regrade keeps the climb as a dead-end spur and adds a working catwalk 1.4 m above the row, because the terraced room failed its own sightline criterion at every case. Tracker question LweZ97oG (Earth Compression) is unanswered and nothing here depends on it.

claims.statement: The three cases are the TOGETHER-SAME row: G pro/pro, H anti/anti, I blue anti with red pro, bound to the live catalog ids tnd-tog-same-gggg, -hhhh and -iiii.

Out of the vestibule one ramp climbs 1.8 m to a dead-end overlook spur and another falls 1.0 m to a catwalk that runs the row 1.4 m above the rootbed. There is no way down onto the bed. The terrain is 2.5D, so the spur is walked and walked back rather than looped.

The payoff is a single eye on the landing at plan (30.5, 13.0), from which the three unison figures nest away down one axis and read as one shape at three scales: 3.79 m at 22.5 degrees, 10.60 m at 7.9, 17.56 m at 4.7.
Elemental associations are never spoken in the wing. The only text on the shell is the class stamp TOGETHER-SAME and the three case letters.

Three control consoles are set into the catwalk south rail, one opposite each case, capped level with the door datum. From a console its own case reads at 4.28 m and 22.7 degrees below the horizon with the foot line clear, which is the acceptance criterion of at most 6.00 m and 25 degrees. The consoles are geometry in the plan contract; no interaction reads or writes a sequence through them yet.

validatorState.explanation: One structural fact, reported six times. The validator derives currentGate as the index of the first gate that is not complete, and forbids any gate past currentGate from holding evidence or checks. No gate on this scene has ever been approved, so currentGate is 0, and every piece of real evidence gathered for gates 1, 2 and 4 is therefore illegal. The scene was built through those gates without stopping for approval at each one. There is no value of currentGate that both tells the truth and lets the evidence stand: raising it to 4 trades these six errors for the single error that currentGate must be 0, and additionally claims four completed gates that do not exist. Deleting the evidence to satisfy the counter would destroy real records of work that was actually done. The honest resolution is Austen approving gates as he reviews them, at which point currentGate rises legitimately and these errors disappear on their own. Do not resolve this by stamping approvals.
